findings: All six proposed concepts are owned by party_activity and their definitions consistently scope the values to the party-role record, explicitly excluding application status/dates and business lifecycle/incorporation.

Held-out validation shows 0.0 error rate of present values for all six fields; role_category, role, is_founding, is_current and effective_from_date each cover 110/110 records, and effective_to_date covers 24/110 present values (0.218) with blanks treated as missing rather than fabricated dates.

Enum mappings are closed (passthrough false, default null), so unlisted publisher categories/roles are withheld rather than coerced; observed values (applicant, applicant_agent, applicant, patentee, agent, true/false) all fall inside the declared value sets.
Date parsing accepts ISO-8601 Z timestamps and plain dates; effective_to_date applies null_if before parse_date so blank open-ended roles are abstentions, not dates.

Grain is correctly stated as one party-activity record (party in a role on an application), with application-level columns acknowledged as repeating; the party_activity key includes party_id, role_category, role, application_number and ip_right_type, which is consistent with the caution that party_id alone does not identify a unique relationship.
No legal-form, ABN, ownership, beneficial-interest or enforceability claims are emitted; is_founding is explicitly framed as a party-role flag, not an establishment date or incorporation evidence.
The cohort is described as a patent-prefix subset with no population accuracy claim, and the quality note correctly disclaims semantic truth.
semantic_risks: is_founding is a publisher flag whose exact semantics (founding of what, relative to which entity) are not documented in the supplied evidence; the definition is defensible as a party-role attribute but downstream consumers could still misread it as business establishment. The definition's explicit prohibition mitigates but does not eliminate this.

effective_from_date examples include 2026-04-16, a future-dated value relative to the 2026-11-23 retrieval; this is plausibly a publisher-recorded role start, but it should not be interpreted as an event that has occurred in the business's history.

party_role_category and party_role are near-duplicates; the finer role (patentee, opponent) is not always derivable from the category (applicant, opposition), so both are retained, but consumers may double-count roles if they treat them as independent facts.
effective_to_date coverage of 0.218 reflects genuine open-ended roles; absence of an end date must not be read as the role having ended or the business having ceased.
checked_reuse: ext.licence.category / ext.licence.status — rejected: owned by licence, describes an authorisation, not a party's role on an application.
ext.licence.start_date / ext.licence.end_date — rejected: owned by licence, not the validity window of a party-role association.
ext.entity.date_established — rejected: owned by business and a date, whereas is_founding is a boolean party-role flag; reuse would change owner, type and meaning.
response.rationale: The group's six concepts are semantically defensible: each is owned by party_activity, scoped to the party-role record, and explicitly separated from application-level status/dates and from business establishment or legal form. Held-out validation shows zero error rate of present values across all six fields, with honest partial coverage on effective_to_date (0.218) reflecting genuinely blank open-ended roles rather than fabricated dates. Enum mappings are closed and withhold unlisted values, and date parsing handles the observed ISO-8601 Z format with blank-to-null handling. No legal-form, ABN, ownership or enforceability claims are made, and the cohort is correctly described as a non-population patent-prefix subset. Residual risks (undocumented is_founding semantics, future-dated effective_from_date, category/role near-duplication) are documented as semantic risks rather than blocking defects, since the definitions already bound their meaning. No blocking findings; repair_scope none.
